integrity_notes: Exact rational base witnesses and their uniform block extension are supplied as reproducibility evidence; the general assertions have mathematical proofs and do not extrapolate solely from finite tests. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All claims require n at least five and an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero.
The singular locus is classified as reduced support, not as a primary decomposition of its Jacobian scheme.
Generic transverse types are proved; higher degenerations at intersections of the components are not classified.
A related 2026 paper on Euler stratifications of second hypersimplices was accessible only through its abstract; possible further overlap is not ruled out.
title: The dual of the second hypersimplex has \(n+1\) singular components
